description: Unit tests for the JobQueue class in the starboard player module, testing job execution order, ownership, cancellation, removal, threading, and move semantics.

classes.name: JobQueueTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for JobQueue unit tests, inheriting from Google Test and JobQueue::JobOwner.

methods.name: OwnedScheduledJobsAreExecutedInOrder
methods.description: Test that scheduled jobs are executed in the correct order based on scheduling and delay.

methods.name: OwnedJobsAreRemovedWhenOwnerGoesOutOfScope
methods.description: Test that jobs owned by a JobOwner are canceled when the owner goes out of scope.

methods.name: CancelPendingJobsCancelsPendingJobs
methods.description: Test that canceling pending jobs works correctly.

methods.name: RemovedJobsAreRemoved
methods.description: Test that removing jobs by token prevents their execution.

methods.name: RunUntilStoppedExecutesAllRemainingJobs
methods.description: Test that RunUntilStopped executes all remaining jobs and respects timing.

methods.name: JobsAreMovedAndNotCopied
methods.description: Test that jobs are moved, not copied, when scheduled.

methods.name: QueueBelongsToCorrectThread
methods.description: Test that the job queue correctly identifies its thread.
